dma:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 284" class="chart diag" role="img" aria-label="差分阵把两路麦克风相减得到与频率无关的指向性，低频输出被压低 kd 倍，均衡器把它拉回来的同时，把各通道独立的自噪声按完全相同的倍数放大">
<defs><marker id="dma" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--text-2)"/></marker><marker id="dmh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--hot)"/></marker><marker id="dms" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s1)"/></marker><marker id="dmw" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s2)"/></marker></defs>
<text x="10" y="18" class="ct">差分阵：指向性来自相减，代价来自把它补回来<tspan class="cu"> · 两条路径，同一个增益</tspan></text>
<rect x="18" y="66" width="64" height="30" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="50.0" y="85.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">mic 1</text>
<rect x="18" y="130" width="64" height="30" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="50.0" y="149.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">mic 2</text>
<text x="50" y="178" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">间距 d < 20 mm</text>
<path d="M82,81 L128,81 L128,89 L155,89" class="ar" marker-end="url(#dma)"/>
<rect x="90" y="130" width="62" height="30" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="121.0" y="149.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">延迟 τ</text>
<path d="M152,145 L172,145 L172,104" class="ar" marker-end="url(#dma)"/>
<circle cx="172" cy="89" r="15" class="bx-a"/>
<text x="172" y="94" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">Σ</text>
<text x="156" y="72" class="bsub">+</text>
<text x="186" y="112" class="bsub">−</text>
<line x1="187" y1="89" x2="226" y2="89" class="ar" marker-end="url(#dma)"/>
<rect x="230" y="69" width="96" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="278.0" y="86.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">差分输出</text><text x="278.0" y="100.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">|H| = 2sin(kd/2)</text>
<line x1="326" y1="89" x2="366" y2="89" class="ar" marker-end="url(#dma)"/>
<rect x="370" y="69" width="96" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-h"/><text x="418.0" y="86.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">低频均衡</text><text x="418.0" y="100.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">×1/|H|</text>
<line x1="466" y1="89" x2="506" y2="89" class="ar" marker-end="url(#dma)"/>
<rect x="510" y="69" width="80" height="40" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="550.0" y="86.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">输出</text><text x="550.0" y="100.0" class="bsub" text-anchor="middle">DI 恒 6 dB</text>
<text x="230" y="54" class="bsub" fill="var(--s1)">目标信号：被压低 kd 倍</text>
<text x="370" y="54" class="bsub" fill="var(--s1)">→ 拉回原样 ✓</text>
<path d="M50,188 L50,214 L404,214 L404,116" class="ar-h" marker-end="url(#dmh)" stroke-dasharray="4 3"/>
<text x="58" y="208" class="bsub" fill="var(--hot)">麦克风自噪声：各通道独立，相减不减小</text>
<text x="414" y="208" class="bsub" fill="var(--hot)">→ 被同一个 1/|H| 放大 ✗</text>
<text x="14" y="252" class="arlab">两条路径穿过<tspan font-weight="600">同一个均衡器</tspan>，所以"均衡增益"和"WNG 的负值"必然是同一个数——07 节那张表最后两列相等，不是巧合。</text>
<text x="14" y="270" class="arlab">d = 15 mm、200 Hz 时 kd = 0.055：目标被压 25 dB，均衡补 25 dB，自噪声也就被抬了 25 dB。</text>
</svg>

aecpos:
<svg viewBox="0 0 700 320" class="chart diag" role="img" aria-label="AEC 的三种放置方案：每通道各一个 AEC 放在最前算力翻 M 倍但严格正确；波束在前只需一个 AEC 但时变权重让它无法收敛；折中方案用固定波束降维后再做 AEC">
<defs><marker id="aea" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--text-2)"/></marker><marker id="aeh" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--hot)"/></marker><marker id="aes" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s1)"/></marker><marker id="aew" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" fill="var(--s2)"/></marker></defs>
<text x="10" y="18" class="ct">AEC 放哪：三种方案，代价完全不同<tspan class="cu"> · 差别就在那几个方块的先后</tspan></text>
<text x="14" y="74" class="blab">A　AEC 在前</text>
<text x="14" y="92" class="bsub">× M 算力</text>
<text x="116" y="46" class="bsub">M 路输入</text>
<rect x="116" y="52" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-w"/><text x="162.0" y="74.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">AEC ×M</text>
<line x1="208" y1="70" x2="224" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="224" y="52" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="270.0" y="74.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">去混响</text>
<line x1="316" y1="70" x2="332" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="332" y="52" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="378.0" y="74.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">自适应波束</text>
<line x1="440" y1="70" x2="456" y2="70" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<text x="462" y="74" class="bsub">1 路</text>
<text x="470" y="104" class="bsub" fill="var(--s3)">唯一严格正确</text>
<text x="14" y="150" class="blab">B　波束在前</text>
<text x="14" y="168" class="bsub">× 1 算力</text>
<text x="116" y="122" class="bsub">M 路输入</text>
<rect x="116" y="128" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="162.0" y="150.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">自适应波束</text>
<line x1="208" y1="146" x2="224" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="224" y="128" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-w"/><text x="270.0" y="150.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">AEC ×1</text>
<line x1="316" y1="146" x2="332" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="332" y="128" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="378.0" y="150.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">后处理</text>
<line x1="440" y1="146" x2="456" y2="146" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<text x="462" y="150" class="bsub">1 路</text>
<text x="470" y="180" class="bsub" fill="var(--s2)">权重时变 → AEC 永不收敛</text>
<text x="14" y="226" class="blab">C　折中</text>
<text x="14" y="244" class="bsub">× 1~2 算力</text>
<text x="116" y="198" class="bsub">M 路输入</text>
<rect x="116" y="204" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-a"/><text x="162.0" y="226.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">固定波束</text>
<line x1="208" y1="222" x2="224" y2="222" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="224" y="204" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx-w"/><text x="270.0" y="226.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">AEC ×2~4</text>
<line x1="316" y1="222" x2="332" y2="222" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<rect x="332" y="204" width="92" height="36" rx="4" class="bx"/><text x="378.0" y="226.0" class="blab" text-anchor="middle">自适应</text>
<line x1="440" y1="222" x2="456" y2="222" class="ar" marker-end="url(#aea)"/>
<text x="462" y="226" class="bsub">1 路</text>
<text x="470" y="256" class="bsub" fill="var(--s1)">牺牲自适应能力，换可收敛</text>
<line x1="14" y1="270" x2="686" y2="270" class="grid"/>
<text x="14" y="290" class="arlab"><tspan font-weight="600">智能音箱选 A</tspan>——扬声器就在麦旁边，回声强到不消干净后面全废，算力硬吃。　<tspan font-weight="600">会议设备选 C</tspan>——8~16 路先用固定波束降到 2~4 路再 AEC。</text>
<text x="14" y="308" class="arlab" fill="var(--s2)">B 只在波束完全固定时才成立。一旦上自适应就会翻车，而症状（回声偶尔冒一下）极难定位——这是这一节最值钱的一句话。</text>
